title: 第5章 世家和上宗第6章 大道文字
content_zh:
原主的便宜爹为什么会问起“封魔朱笔”
？他是真的只是随口一问，还是在试探什么？
再有，“封魔朱笔”
居然是原主的母亲留给他的……我之前在梦中看到的记忆里并没提到这件事……果然，接收记忆就和开“盲盒”
差不多，由此可见兑换列表里的“妖道”
记忆就是个坑啊。
被赵嵩安排在了冰凌院内一个房间休息的赵晨低头沉思了一阵，又注意到了另外一件事：
原主的亲生母亲是在八年前去世的，也就是说，“封魔朱笔”
作为“大日星槎”
缺失的部件，至少于原主家里存在了八年，这意味着他在落入这个世界后，并不是直接就成为了赵晨，而是“沉睡”
了相当长的一段时间。
“也不知道其他那些部件在外界有没有神异……如果有的话，它们中大部分恐怕已经落到修行者手里，想要找回怕是很麻烦啊！”
微叹口气，赵晨在客房的软塌上辗转反侧了好一阵才沉沉睡去。
第二天清晨，赵晨早早就起了床，在侍女的服侍下洗漱完毕，这才再次登入冰凌院的正堂，给父母请安。
——不是他穿越第一天就心安理得地享受起腐败的生活，而是这个时代的生活对他来说还太过陌生，需要一些“新手”
引导。
然而，他很快就被告知“父亲”
赵嵩昨夜就离了家，而继母还得照料他刚出生的弟弟，也没空管他，所以赵晨只是简单用过早饭，就带上小厮风曲去往了金镖武馆。
相对于昨日的高朋满座、喧嚣热闹，今天的武馆显得格外冷清，就连习武的弟子们也有一多半都没来，偌大的白沙地院子里只有五六个人在站着桩。
经过通报，赵晨再次见到了“自家”

的师傅“金镖客”
黄显钧。
这位高大的老者有着狮子鼻，方海口，眼中依旧神采奕奕，若非左肩膀上用白布进行着包扎，一点也看不出昨天才刚刚受过子弹的贯穿伤。
“参见师傅……见过冯仓师兄……”
赵晨依照记忆里的礼仪，向面前的师傅和师兄行过礼。
黄显钧虚扶了一下自己这个刚入门三天的弟子，简单寒暄了几句后就微笑问道：“你一早上门，可是决定和老夫一起离开冰泉镇，去往玉门？”
“正是……既然拜了师傅，自然要和师门有难同当。”
赵晨诚恳地表了态，然后才说出了那句师傅此刻最想听的话，“家父决定派一支火铳小队送我去玉门郡城，还请师傅不要介意。”
黄显钧心里顿时松了口气，但表面不显，只微微点头，然后才亲切地拉起自家徒弟的手，将早已准备好的一本册子交给了他。
赵晨视线下移，好奇地看了一眼，发现那本册子的封面上用正楷写着一行文字：“金楼玉室十二重门行气秘录”
黄显钧见徒弟接过秘籍，才放开他的手，然后捋了捋自己的花白须髯，组织语句道：
content_en:
Why did the original owner’s cheap dad ask about the “Devil-Sealing Vermilion Pen”?
? Was he really just asking casually, or was he testing something?
And again, "Demon Sealing Vermilion Pen"
It turned out to be left to him by the mother of the original owner... The memory I saw in my dream before did not mention this matter... Sure enough, receiving the memory is the same as opening a "blind box"
Almost, this shows the "demon path" in the exchange list
Memory is a trap.
Zhao Chen, who was arranged by Zhao Song to rest in a room in the Bingling Courtyard, lowered his head and thought for a while, and then noticed another thing:
The original owner’s biological mother passed away eight years ago, that is to say, the “Devil-sealing Zhubi”
As the "Great Sun Star"
The missing parts have existed in the original owner's home for at least eight years, which means that after falling into this world, he did not directly become Zhao Chen, but "sleeped"
for quite some time.
"I don't know if those other parts have any magical properties in the outside world... If so, most of them have probably fallen into the hands of practitioners. It would be very troublesome to retrieve them!"
With a slight sigh, Zhao Chen tossed and turned on the soft floor of the guest room for a while before falling into a deep sleep.
In the early morning of the next day, Zhao Chen got up early, washed up under the service of the maid, and then entered the main hall of Bingling Courtyard again to pay his respects to his parents.
——It’s not that he could enjoy the corrupt life with peace of mind on the first day after traveling, but that the life in this era is still too unfamiliar to him and he needs some “novices”
guide.
However, he was soon told that "Father"
Zhao Song left home last night, and his stepmother had to take care of his newborn brother and had no time to take care of him, so Zhao Chen simply had breakfast and took Xiaosi Fengqu to the Golden Dart Martial Arts Hall.
Compared to yesterday's crowds of guests and bustle, today's martial arts hall seemed particularly deserted. Even more than half of the martial arts disciples were absent. There were only five or six people standing in the huge white sand courtyard.
After the report, Zhao Chen saw "his family" again
The master of "Golden Guards"
Huang Xianjun.
This tall old man has a lion's nose and a square mouth, and his eyes are still full of energy. If his left shoulder had not been bandaged with white cloth, there would be no trace of the penetrating wound suffered by a bullet just yesterday.
"Meet the master...meet the senior brother Feng Cang..."
Zhao Chen saluted the master and senior brother in front of him according to the etiquette in his memory.
Huang Xianjun helped him, a disciple who had just started for three days, and after a few simple greetings, he smiled and asked: "You came in early in the morning, but decided to leave Bingquan Town with me and go to Yumen?"
"Exactly...since I have become a master, I naturally have to share the difficulties with my master."
Zhao Chen expressed his attitude sincerely, and then said what the master wanted to hear most at the moment, "My father has decided to send a firecracker team to send me to Yumen County. Please don't mind, master."
Huang Xianjun was relieved in his heart, but he didn't show it on the surface. He only nodded slightly, then kindly took his apprentice's hand and handed him a booklet he had prepared.
Zhao Chen lowered his eyes, took a curious look, and found a line of text written in block letters on the cover of the booklet: "Secret Records of the Twelve Doors of the Jinlou and Jade Rooms"
When Huang Xianjun saw his apprentice take over the secret book, he let go of his hand, then smoothed his gray beard and organized his sentences:
